lines.text: The seal is still whole. Why bring it to my table if you won't tell me whose hand I must trust?
The courier said the silver coin buys a guide through the north pass. He didn't say who sent the letter.
That stamp matches the coin. Look—the same little star. The pass is our only road home before dawn.
Then we open it together. If the sender wants us home, we spend the coin at first light.
